## Change

Describe the RHS-IA behavior or repository maintenance change and link the relevant RHS-IA issue, if any.

## Validation

List the exact commands run, their outcomes, and any manual or packaged checks. Compile before tests. State affected platforms and those not tested.

## Customization and compatibility

If the change affects an RHS-IA customization, update both `docs/upgrades/rhs-customizations.md` and `docs/upgrades/rhs-customizations.json`. Explain any persisted setting, extension ID, profile, or credential migration. Preserve upstream copyright, license, and dependency identifiers where required.

## Release notes

State whether this needs an RHS-IA release note or deployment action.
